claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User registers and processes submitted claim forms from VSPs to validate information, quarantine incomplete or false claims, and prepare financial reports for payment arrangement.

goal.raw_text: The MSIU Field Office User registers and processes submitted claim forms from VSPs to validate information, quarantine incomplete or false claims, and prepare financial reports for payment arrangement.

claims.content: MSIU Field Office User
The claim form must be filled out by the attending doctor at the VSP clinic or hospital.
The patient must provide the voucher according to visit type and patient type, and it must be stuck to the claim form.
A thumb print must be obtained from the patient and placed on the claim form upon completion of service.
All mandatory information on the claim form must be complete; otherwise, the system will not accept the claim.
The VSP must submit the collected claim forms to the MSIU field office.
During submission entry, all required fields including VSP Name, Date of Submission, No of Mentioned Forms, No of Available Forms, and Treatment Form No must be provided.
The date of submission recorded in the system must be the current date.
The VSP submits the collected claim forms to the MSIU field office.

trigger.raw_text: The VSP submits the collected claim forms to the MSIU field office.

claims.content: The VSP sends the collected claim forms monthly to the MSIU field office.
The MSIU field office receives the claim forms and begins processing.
During submission entry, the user captures mandatory details: VSP Name, Date of Submission, No of Mentioned Forms, No of Available Forms, and Treatment Form No.
The system validates that all mandatory information is complete; if not, it rejects the claim.
The field office validates the claim form manually and through the system for accuracy and completeness.
If mandatory information is missing or false information exists, the claim is rejected and quarantined in the system.
Quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification; if corrected satisfactorily, they are re-entered in the next month’s batch.
Based on agreed payment terms, the field office generates bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reports and sends them to the MSIU Admin team for payment arrangement.

If mandatory information is missing or false information is detected during validation, the claim is rejected and quarantined; quarantined forms are returned to the VSP for correction, and if corrected satisfactorily, they are re-entered in the following month’s batch.
Before claim entry, if the user manually checks the form and finds missing mandatory information, the claim status is marked as Rejected and sent back to the VSP.

If mandatory information is missing or false information is detected during validation (manual or system), the claim is rejected, quarantined in the system, and sent back to the VSP for verification; if corrected satisfactorily, it is re-entered in the following month’s batch.
Before claim entry, if the user manually checks the form and finds missing mandatory information, the claim status is marked as Rejected and sent back to the VSP without system entry.

If the thumb impression on a claim form mismatches previous visits for the same patient/voucher, the system automatically quarantines the claim; if more than two such mismatches occur from the same VSP, the system produces a warning and inactivates the VSP.
The system will not accept any claim unless all mandatory information is complete; incomplete claims are rejected at point of entry.
The claim form has been validated manually and through the system by the field office.
If mandatory information is missing or false information exists, the claim is rejected and kept in a quarantine area in the system.
Quarantined forms are sent back to the VSP for verification; if corrected satisfactorily, they are entered into the system in the following month's batch.
Based on agreed payment terms, the field office generates bi-monthly or monthly financial and medical reports and sends them to the MSIU Admin team for payment arrangement.
Client feedback documents obtained by the MSIU Admin team are sent to the field office to be entered into the database.
